facts.text: A vertical composite character reference sheet: a large hero image at the top, a middle row of full-body FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK panels, and a bottom row of close-up FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS panels.
The recurring subject is an adult with short dark hair, shaved sides, and a small tied bun at the back of the head, plus a visible scar line near the left eyebrow.
The subject wears an all-black outfit: a high-collared tactical jacket with straps and a metal buckle, a black undershirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the top hero image, the subject stands full-body on a wet reflective walkway, body slightly angled, head turned toward the viewer's left and gazing off-camera, with arms at the sides.
The hero setting is a rainy nighttime rooftop or industrial walkway with metal railings on both sides, blurred city lights, warm amber bokeh, and wet pavement reflecting the lights.
The FRONT panel shows the subject standing upright facing the camera with arms at the sides against a dark charcoal background.
The SIDE PROFILE panel shows the subject standing upright in profile facing the viewer's left, revealing the tied hair and the jacket's side silhouette.
The BACK panel shows the subject standing upright facing away from the camera, displaying the back of the jacket, trousers, and boots.
The FACE panel is a frontal head-and-shoulders close-up with a serious neutral expression, short cropped sides, and the small tied bun visible at the back.
The JACKET COLLAR panel is a close-up of the jacket's high collar, zipper, textured fabric, strap, and metal buckle.
The HANDS panel is a close-up of two relaxed hands with visibly grimy or weathered skin.
The BOOTS panel is a close-up of a pair of worn black lace-up combat boots on a dark reflective surface, with scuffs and wet or dirty detailing.
Visible labels in the image read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.

The overall look is cinematic and low-key, using cool blue-gray night tones, black clothing, and warm amber light accents in the hero image, while the reference panels use soft directional lighting against dark backgrounds.
